commonProblems.h2: Peugeot 207 Petrol Engine Codes - Full Technical Specifications & Replacement Guide
commonProblems.h3: Every petrol engine code fitted to the Peugeot 207 across all generations, with technical specs, compatible variants and trims, known failure points, and average rebuilt prices from UK specialists. Select any engine code to compare quotes.

finalCta.paragraph: History: The turbocharged Prince variant powered the THP and RC models, delivering 150-175hp with direct injection. The THP engine's problems stem from three major design flaws: an undersized hydraulic timing chain tensioner, faulty piston rings causing excessive oil consumption, and an inadequate turbo lubrication system. These defects particularly affect EP6DT (150hp) and EP6CDT (156hp) engines produced before April 2010.
